# Cairo Branch Handbook

## 1. Office hours

The Cairo office is open from 09:00 to 18:00, Sunday to Thursday. Access outside
those hours needs a badge exception raised with facilities.

## 2. Transport allowance

Employees based in Cairo receive a monthly transport allowance paid with salary.
The allowance is branch-specific and does not apply to other locations.

## 3. Local holidays

The Cairo office observes the national holiday calendar in addition to the
company-wide days listed in the leave policy.

## 4. Facilities

Desk bookings are made through the facilities system. Meeting rooms on the
fourth floor are reserved for client visits.
